'''Michael Vaughn''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Huntsville tournament]] in December 2000 with Endor start, according to Steven Lewis's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1545">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-14-huntsville-al-closed-environmentd1545/ huntsville-al-closed-environment], DeckTech (Steven "Sir Yoda" Lewis, 14 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-14-huntsville-al-closed-environmentd1545/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
